info.title: BIKIE API
info.description: Stable v1 contract under `/api/*`. Flutter and web share this surface. `/api/v2` is reserved for approved breaking changes only (ADR-028). Schemas are incrementally detailed; treat `.docs/API.md` as the narrative source of truth.

BearerAuth.description: Better Auth bearer token (Flutter / mobile). Header: Authorization: Bearer <token>.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation id for logs/telemetry (optional on responses).

Deprecation.description: RFC 9745-style signal when an operation is deprecated.

Sunset.description: HTTP-date when a deprecated operation may be removed.
